title: Cloud and Infrastructure Engineer (Power Platform)
jobDescription:
Are you a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys building reliable, secure, and modern workplace platforms?

We’re looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer (Power Platform) to help us design and run solutions across Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and core infrastructure. You’ll work close to both technical teams and the business, shaping platform capabilities and making sure services run smoothly, securely, and efficiently.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on engineering, solution design, and solving complex technical challenges in a collaborative environment.

Your role:

  • Design, implement, and support solutions across Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and infrastructure services with focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Ensure M365, Power Platform, and infrastructure services are operated according to agreed standards, policies, and security requirements.
  • Drive continuous service improvement activities across the Digital landscape in alignment with best practices and strategy.
  • Ensure adherence to IT security policies and architectural guidelines across all supported technologies.
  • Provide 3rd-level support for complex issues across Power Platform, M365, and infrastructure components.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and ensure successful deployment of new or enhanced capabilities.
  • Support knowledge transfer and training for 1st and 2nd line support teams.
    Stay updated on technological developments across Power Platform, M365, Azure, and infrastructure domains.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or platform engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience and strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and related components.
  • Hands-on experience managing Microsoft Power Platform environments (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power BI governance).
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions, design and deploy new or enhanced platform capabilities.
  • Good understanding of security, identity (Azure AD / Entra), and platform operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to handle complex technical challenges.
  • Ability to work effectively in a complex technical environment and collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, both technical and business oriented.

What do we offer?

  • Amazing opportunity to work closely with colleagues locally and internationally 
  • An opportunity to work in a modern, cloud-first digital environment within a global organization.
  • Hybrid work-model
  • Annual bonus 
  • Private health care package (fully financed by the company) 
  • Group insurance  
  • Benefits cafeteria with Multisport card co-financed
  • Access to Hempel Academy learning platform
  • Extra paid long holidays 

Application and further information 

To apply for this position, please submit your application with a CV in English. We’re excited to welcome a new colleague to our Digital team in Gdańsk office. Apply today and become part of our journey!

title: Intern Low Code Consultant (Mendix, Pega, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, German) (Gdańsk, PL)
jobDescription:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your role

Low‑code is a fast‑growing, future‑shaping technology that lets you build real applications visually. It turns problem‑solvers, analysts, and creative thinkers into makers by using intuitive drag‑and‑drop tools to deliver solutions at high speed. Because it focuses on logic, collaboration, and understanding business processes, it’s an ideal starting point even for people who aren’t traditional developers. All you need is curiosity, analytical thinking, and a drive to learn. If you're looking for an exciting, accessible way to launch your career in digital development, low‑code is the perfect path.

As an Intern Low‑Code Consultant, you will start your journey in this growing technology area by learning how to design and configure low‑code applications. This entry‑level role combines structured onboarding, hands‑on learning, and real project work, with close support from experienced consultants and developers.

Your project

Capgemini Poland’s Application Business Line (ABL) runs one of the strongest Low-Code Hub in Poland – a place where experienced engineers, architects, and curious minds come together to reshape how software is created.

With over 400+ professionals, we drive digital transformation by building deep expertise across a wide range of lowcode technologies, working with platforms such as Mendix, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Pega, SAP, ServiceNow, and more.

We enable businesses to deliver solutions that accelerate application development, streamline workflows, integrate systems seamlessly, and drive innovation.

Your tasks

  • You will create low‑code solutions by configuring process logic, forms, and business rules, supporting international projects for large organizations, with guidance from experienced team members.
  • You will work in a highly agile, collaborative team, delivering solutions iteratively and adapting quickly to change.
  • You will verify and validate implemented solutions, identify issues, and support troubleshooting activities.
  • You will document your work and decisions to ensure clarity, quality, and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • You will continuously learn and develop your low code skills through hands on practice, internal training and project assignments.

Your profile

  • You demonstrate analytical, process‑oriented thinking and enjoy understanding how things work end to end.
  • You can explain complex ideas clearly, listen actively, and manage expectations in a pragmatic way.
  • You take ownership of your work, care about quality, and are eager to learn and grow.
  • No prior low‑code or programming experience is required – we will support your learning from the ground up.
  • You communicate confidently in English, while German proficiency is major plus for this role.

Your development path

  • During your first months, you will learn a specific low‑code platform step by step, combining self‑learning materials with hands‑on guidance from experienced colleagues.
  • You will gradually start supporting real project work, beginning with well‑defined tasks that allow you to learn fast and build confidence.
  • Over time, you will take on more responsibility within the team, contributing to the design, configuration, and improvement of business processes.
  • Your development will be closely supported through regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with consultants and developers around you.

What You'll love about working here

  • Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Architects, Google) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First language platform, Pluralsight, TED Talks, Coursera and Udemy Business materials and trainings.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Position yourself at the forefront of IT innovation, working with the latest technologies and platforms. Capgemini partners with top global enterprises, including 145 Fortune 500 companies.
  • Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details.
  • Practical benefits: private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and 40+ options on our NAIS benefit platform, including Netflix, Spotify or Sports card.

Get to know us

Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.

Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube. 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

title: Continuous Improvement Automation Specialist
jobDescription:
Group Services

Metsä Group is a successful forest industry group with roots in the Finnish forest - Our parent company is a cooperative of over 90,000 forest owners. Metsä Group’s Group Services employ some 1,000 professionals in finance, IT, sourcing and logistics, HR, technology, business process development, communications, law, and many other fields. Their task is to support Metsä Group and its Business Areas in implementing their strategy. Our specialists’ independent work is supported by a strongly networked workplace community.

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds and different stages of life. Metsä has space and opportunities for many kinds of talent, regardless of age, gender, ethnic background, sexual orientation, disability or other characteristics – Metsä is for all. Read more: metsagroup.com/metsaforall.

This recruitment is carried out anonymously.

We are looking for a Continuous Improvement Automation Specialist to join Metsä Group´s Continuous Improvement Team.


What Will You Do?

As a Continuous Improvement Automation Specialist at Metsä Group, you will play a key role within the Finance Shared Service Center (SSC) by enhancing productivity and quality. This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining automation scripts, tools, and applications to streamline business processes. Responsibilities include identifying automation opportunities in collaboration with teams, maintaining and optimizing existing scripts, and ensuring the reliability and performance of automated solutions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining automation scripts and tools to streamline business processes.
  • Collaborating with teams to identify opportunities for automation that enhance productivity and quality.
  • Administering local applications (e.g., SharePoint, Teams) to support operational needs.
  • Maintaining and documenting existing automation scripts to ensure reliability and continuity.
  • Introducing best practices for automation, identifying inefficiencies, and driving process improvements.
  • Preparing agreed reports to support operations.
  • Supporting the development of technical skills among other team members.

Location: This position is based in Gdańsk (Poland). We operate in a hybrid working model, which includes the flexibility of remote work combined with the expectation to be present in the office at least three days per week.


What are we looking for?

We are looking for a customer-oriented professional who can understand client needs, deliver effective solutions, and clearly communicate the value of their work. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, learns quickly, and works independently. They are open to new challenges, cooperative, and communicate effectively while working closely with clients and teams.

Key qualifications and attributes include:

  • Knowledge of Power Automate Desktop and Cloud, Power Apps
  • Excel advanced skills
  • Basic knowledge of any programming language
  • General IT skills on a very good level
  • Basic understanding of SAP FI module
  • Familiarized with accounting processes and terminology
  • 3+ years’ experience in Power Platform development
  • Languages: Fluency in English required

Nice to have:

  • Experience in AI services implementation
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Automate RPA Developer Associate
  • UiPath or Blue Prism
  • Previous experience in SSC/BPO sector
  • Knowledge of process improvement techniques (Lean/Six Sigma)
  • Knowledge of VBA, Python, Power Query

What do we offer? 

  • Work in an international environment in an centrally located office in Gdańsk

  • Stable job and cooperation with a friendly and high qualified team

  • We will make sure that you have training that will ensure your proper development

  • benefits including lunch card, Multisport card, health care and life insurance

  • Hybrid work (2 days per week working from home allowed)

  • Attractive location of the office: 4 minutes to SKM, trams and buses.

Career in the new era at Metsä Group

The best sparring for business – deepen your expertise as a specialist. At Metsä Group, you’ll work with professionals from many fields. Our atmosphere is open, and it’s easy for newcomers to fit in. We want to renew the business by striving for positive impacts on the environment and society. This means significant development opportunities and agile projects, competence development, and understanding the business. Our big company offers a wide range of career opportunities and many interesting challenges.

Metsä Group has a responsible corporate culture that creates a safe working environment for all of us. We value good leadership and support for personal career development. We encourage you to display your competence and will provide you with opportunities to use it.

Enter a new era in your career,​ welcome to Metsä Group!

title: Lead AIOps Engineer
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Lead AIOps Engineer to help build and scale AI-driven operations across the full service management lifecycle. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn operational signals and service management data into actionable intelligence and automation that improves reliability, reduces manual effort, accelerates recovery, and increases delivery velocity.

You will lead the engineering work to deliver production-grade capabilities such as event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, automated remediation, and intelligent workflow automation. The value of AIOps is highest when it reduces noise, surfaces actionable insights earlier, and connects those insights to automated actions across incident, change, release, and request workflows.

If you are passionate about technology, thrive on learning, and want to build practical AI systems that create measurable operational and delivery outcomes, this role is for you.

About the Role

In this opportunity as a Lead AIOps Engineer, you will:

  • Build and deploy AIOps capabilities that reduce alert fatigue and improve incident response, including event correlation and noise reduction techniques.

  • Develop and productionize machine learning approaches for operational use cases such as anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and early-warning signals from telemetry and operational data.

  • Design and implement data pipelines that ingest, normalize, and enrich high-volume operational signals and service management data (for example: monitoring signals combined with tickets, changes, releases, and operational knowledge) to enable intelligent automation.

  • Create and maintain automation (scripts, runbooks, workflows) that turns insights into action and enables automated incident response and remediation, with appropriate safeguards and validation steps.

  • Engineer intelligent, AI-native service management workflows that reduce friction and cycle time, such as smarter routing, enrichment, summarization, and decision support across incident, change, and release workflows.

  • Partner with engineering and platform teams to automate release and change activities where possible, including automated change creation, deployment signal ingestion, release health checks, post-deployment verification, and rollback decision support, to accelerate time-to-market while reducing risk.

  • Establish engineering standards for model performance, explainability, and safe automation, including feedback loops to reduce false positives and improve trust over time.

  • Mentor and guide other engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, patterns, and reusable components.

About You

You’re a fit for the role of Lead AIOps Engineer if you have the following required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, ML engineering, data engineering, DevOps/SRE, platform engineering, or automation-heavy operations roles.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on AI/ML development and engineering experience, including building and training models and deploying them into production or production-like environments.

  • Strong coding ability (Python plus other languages used for services and automation) and experience building reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience working with operational telemetry such as metrics, logs, events, and traces, and using those signals to drive detection and response.

  • Experience connecting operational intelligence to workflow execution through automation or orchestration, with a bias toward simplifying processes and accelerating delivery.

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous problems into shipped solutions that improve operational and delivery outcomes.

  • A genuine passion for technology and continuous learning, with a track record of staying current as tools and techniques evolve.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AIOps, event intelligence, or observability platforms focused on correlation and actionable incident reduction.

  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and model lifecycle practices such as monitoring, retraining, and evaluation.

  • Experience with cloud platforms and modern infrastructure patterns including containers, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code.

  • Experience integrating AI-driven insights with service management workflows, including change and release automation patterns.

Why this role matters

  • Modern environments generate more operational and service management data than humans can manually interpret in real time. AIOps helps teams detect anomalies, correlate signals, predict issues, and reduce noise so engineers can focus on what matters.

  • In this role, you will build systems that improve reliability and customer experience while also improving delivery speed by making service management workflows more intelligent, automated, and AI-native.

#LI-AB3

What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations.

For Poland, the base compensation range for this role is 203,000 PLN - 377,000 PLN.

Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.
This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

YOUR TEAM/ PROJECT:

Capgemini's Digital Customer Experience (DCX) practice helps global brands as well as public organizations to understand and implement the right mix of business-focused digital capabilities and innovations following a “Customer-First” approach. Our development teams are responsible for end-to-end enterprise application development process using the newest technologies. They are highly independent, capable in Agile Process and Lean Software Engineering practices. In our daily work, we foster good communication and the culture of feedback. Following the motto “Get the future you want”, we offer a wide variety of learning and personal development opportunities.

As a Dynamics 365 Consultant, you play a key role in the Agile delivery of business applications focused on the CRM domain at an enterprise scale. You will join an international team that delivers some of the biggest and most exciting IT projects, all built on top of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform. You will be working with people ranging in experience, from early and emerging talent to specialists. You will work in a cloud-first environment with a strong focus on DevOps practices from design to production.

YOUR TASKS:

  • Understanding the needs, goals, and objectives of the customer, and ensure that the solution which gets built fits the organization in the longer term.
  • Managing and advise the requirements gathering process by running workshops, interviews and observations sessions with Subject Matter Experts and Product Owners to define the business and functional requirements, and system goals.
  • Co-creating together with the customer and present ideas which trigger the imagination of business owners and stakeholders, based on the capabilities of the platform.
  • Helping the Product Owners build the Product Backlog and ensure requirements are documented correctly in User Stories (if possible, using Behavior Driven Development).
  • Working with Solution Architects and Developers to outline high-level and low-level solution designs in line with the capabilities of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, and find together the balance between configuration and customization.

YOUR PROFILE:

  • You are excited about the technologies and capabilities provided by Dynamics 365 and Power Platform – the out-of-the-box capabilities and the limitations, or have experience with other CRM Cloud platforms like Salesforce, Oracle, or SAP.
  • You can translate business needs into great Customer Experience, and can apply best practices when designing and implementing business processes and data models.
  • You are passionate about delivering according to the Agile methodology and can help plan projects and releases in sprints and write Epics, Features and User Stories.
  • You can form strong and lasting relationships with clients and colleagues, and can engage with stakeholders at different levels in an organization.
  • Microsoft certifications related to Dynamics 365 are a great plus.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE:

Practical benefits: permanent employment contract from the first day; hybrid, flexible working model; equipment package for home office; private medical care  with Medicover; life insurance; Capgemini Helpline; NAIS benefit platform.

Access to 70+ training tracks with certification opportunities; platform with free access to Pluralsight, TED Talks, Coursera, Udemy Business and SAP Learning HUB.

Community Hub that will allow you to choose from over 20 professional communities that gather people interested in, among others: Salesforce, Java, Cloud, IoT, Agile, AI. 

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
